title: AGF Competitive Positioning Section
description: Direct competitor analysis. Where AGF sits relative to the consolidated, struggling, and ceiling-defining incumbents — and why each opens a seam.

section_label.description: Short label shown in the section eyebrow after the number (e.g. 'The Consolidation').

intro_text.description: Markdown-formatted positioning thesis. Sets up why each competitor matters to AGF.

category.description: Tier this competitor occupies (e.g., 'luxury electronics', 'aspirational halo', 'consumer flagship').

status.description: Current market state of the competitor.

key_data_points.description: Sourced numbers and dates that anchor the positioning claim.

agf_positioning.description: Markdown-formatted articulation of how AGF positions itself relative to this competitor.

opening.description: Short statement of the seam or vacuum AGF can occupy because of this competitor's state.

source_urls.description: Primary-source links (press releases, SEC filings, public reports).

prestige_score.description: Perceived prestige score (0–100) used by the perceptual-map visualization.

price_usd_avg.description: Average flagship price in USD used by the perceptual-map visualization.

appendix.description: markdown — supporting notes for the appendix

summary.description: Markdown-formatted summary of AGF's overall competitive stance after surveying the field.

_viz_config.description: Chart visualization configuration (editable via Edit UI)
